description: Add a role to the user's JustBacked tracker (shown at justbacked.com/saved) or update its status. Statuses: saved, applied, interviewing, offer, rejected, withdrawn, archived. Use "saved" for roles the user is considering; use "applied" only after the user confirms they submitted. For a role found elsewhere, pass title + company + apply_url instead of job.

applied_at.description: Date applied, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today when status moves past saved.

apply_url.description: The role's application URL, for a role found elsewhere.

company.description: Company name, for a role found elsewhere.

job.description: The job value from search_jobs (a slug), or the role's justbacked.com/jobs URL.

title.description: Role title, for a role found elsewhere (pass with company and apply_url instead of job).

name: track_application
title: Add to application tracker
